verdict.rationale: Secureframe is a compliance automation platform, so an in-platform auditor workspace is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents an auditor role, an auditor portal, or scoped auditor access to controls and evidence. The closest items are a passing mention of 'audit activity' in the notifications hub and general claims about being SOC 2 audit-ready, neither of which shows auditors working directly in the platform instead of exchanging PDFs by email.
